decision.approach: Standalone derivation of Matt Pocock prototype and Lauren Tan pstack prototype playbook.
decision.maintenance_dependency: agent-instructions, only for requested authoring or source maintenance.

adopted: Decision first, disposable artifact, observed evidence, explicit handoff.
Matt logic-demo anatomy and pstack empirical experiments.
Separate upstream inspiration from runtime dependencies.
not_adopted: Mandatory variant counts or a blanket framework ban: use the experiment needed by the question.
Routine confirmation before using app context: preserve existing authorization.
One large entrypoint: retain conditional references for the three modes and requested maintenance.
Labeling pstack as its own repository: record Lauren Tan / pstack as author and cursor/plugins as host.

execution_revision.change: Replaced the abstract recommendation rule with a check against every observed condition after a contradictory heuristic appeared in the first empirical trial. matched_artifact_comparison.conclusion: No claim that the skill outperforms the baseline; the baseline handoff was incomplete and the candidate produced a contradictory additional selection heuristic.

limits: One executor model with a small fixture sample; no general superiority claim.
The complete no-skill baseline exceeded 600 seconds, so end-to-end improvement is unproved.

The empirical candidate initially proposed a rule contradicted by a single-miss observation. The final reference makes the consistency check explicit; both old and new targeted probes avoided that exact rule, so an improvement is not established.
Decision probes reached the intended core choices but added speculative crossover reasoning and imprecise latency-bound language; these probes do not validate statistical reasoning in general.
CLI executors had no browser; the parent separately checked artifacts through the collaborative browser. Screenshot capture in T3 failed and native Dia was used for the available visual inspection.
Executors read more conditional references than necessary; reduced context usage was not demonstrated.
The UI executor also exceeded 600 seconds before its final recommendation; the parent checked the generated artifact, not a completed autonomous handoff.
Automatic host discovery, installation, production framework integration, maintenance updates, and continuation inside an orchestrator were not exercised.
Artifact trials and full traces were temporary; hashes and observations remain in this report after scratch cleanup.
